summary: Two games tonight (CLE at PHI, DEN at OKC). No selection clears the desk's bar: every DraftKings spread and moneyline sits at or below break-even against the desk's probability, the Denver moneyline misses the 0.30 wild-card floor, and no DraftKings price could be read today for a total or a player prop.

notes: Lines: DraftKings via the ESPN feed at 19:44 UTC: PHI -2.5 (1.909 / CLE 1.909), ML PHI 1.704 / CLE 2.20, total 236.5 (both sides assumed 1.91, not read from DraftKings). No-vig: PHI cover 0.500, ML PHI 0.5635 / CLE 0.4365. Articles move the number (TheSpread: PHI -3, total 236, opened -4.5; an 8:52 a.m. ET CBS note: PHI -3.5, total 235.5), none naming DraftKings, so the feed's DraftKings price is the one used.

Model: PHI 114.7, CLE 115.0, margin PHI -0.3, total 229.8, pace 101.1. PHI's ratings are one game; CLE's are league priors (0 games). Treated as no information. Desk margin is anchored to the market at PHI +2.5 (no-vig spread), with a small shift for Allen (below), so the desk's chance is about 0.50 for PHI -2.5 and 0.50 for CLE +2.5.

Availability: CLE Jarrett Allen (C) QUESTIONABLE, right patellar tendinopathy (day-to-day, updated 15:08 UTC). No same-day source says he is expected to play. If he sits, Mobley moves to center and Tyson enters the starting group, a loss of roughly 1 to 2 points of CLE rim protection and rebounding that is not priced by the 1-game model. CLE Khalifa Diop (C) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (F) OUT. PHI Dean Wade (F) QUESTIONABLE, ankle (day-to-day); Tacko Fall, Dominick Barlow and Ariel Hukporti OUT. Joel Embiid is not on the report (available, 33 minutes projected).

Expected starters: PHI Maxey, Brown, LeBron James, Embiid (the 106-100 win over the Knicks used Maxey, Brown and James; Embiid is not on the report). CLE Mitchell, Harden, Mobley, Allen if he plays, Strus or Merrill: not confirmed in any source read today.

Desk read: Allen's questionable status is the one news item that moves the number, and it moves it toward PHI, not CLE. That is not enough to clear 0.52 on either side. CLE +2.5 at 1.909 needs 0.524 to break even; the desk's 0.48 to 0.50 is negative expected value. PHI -2.5 at 1.909 also needs 0.524; the desk's 0.50 to 0.52 is at best break-even.
Moneylines: PHI 1.704 needs 0.587 (desk about 0.56 to 0.58, negative EV); CLE 2.20 needs 0.455 (desk about 0.42 to 0.44, negative EV). No selection.

Totals: model 229.8 vs market 236.5 (the desk's under probability at 0.64 is 14 points from the 0.50 no-vig line). The model is built on priors and one game for PHI, and its league scoring baseline (113.3 per 100) gives a lower environment than the market. No sourced reason survived the re-check, and no DraftKings total price was read today, so no total is selected.
Props: no DraftKings player-prop price was readable today. TheSpread shows Mobley 10+ rebounds at +110 with no book named. Declined. Allen props are off until he is confirmed.
Result: no selections on this game. Every candidate is at or below break-even at the DraftKings price.
injuries: CLE: OUT Khalifa Diop (knee), Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back). QUESTIONABLE Jarrett Allen (right patellar tendinopathy, day-to-day). Official ESPN feed injury list, updated 2026-10-22 15:08 UTC.
PHI: OUT Tacko Fall (quadriceps), Dominick Barlow (back), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, out long-term). QUESTIONABLE Dean Wade (ankle, day-to-day). Joel Embiid not on the report.
The official 2026-10-22 final report was not separately readable; the feed's day-to-day flags are the latest read.

notes: Lines: DraftKings via the ESPN feed at 19:44 UTC: OKC -8.5 (1.952 / DEN +8.5 at 1.87), ML OKC 1.294 / DEN 3.70, total 236.5 (both sides assumed 1.91). Desk margin: OKC by about 8 points (market -8.5 with the feed's price; the model's 7.5 is a prior). Injury net effect is close to zero: both sides' missing players are bench depth (OKC: Nikola Topic, Thomas Sorber out, Otega Oweh out for the season; DEN: Julian Strawther out, Spencer Jones questionable at 21 minutes projected). Nothing in the starting groups changes.

Spread: DEN +8.5 (1.87) needs 0.535 to break even; the desk's cover is Phi((−8.0 + 8.5) / 12.6) = 0.516: negative EV (about −0.035). OKC −8.5 (1.952) needs 0.512; the desk's cover is Phi((8.0 − 8.5)/12.6) = 0.484: negative EV. No selection.

Moneylines: OKC 1.294 is below the spec's 1.35 band floor (ineligible) and its probability (about 0.74 vs break-even 0.77) is negative EV in any case. DEN 3.70 is a wild card (2.21 to 4.50 band) but the desk's win chance Phi(−8.0 / 12.6) = 0.26 is below the 0.30 wild-card floor. Neither qualifies.

Totals: model 230.2 vs market 236.5. The 6-point gap is a re-check trigger (under 0.63 against 0.50). The model is built on priors and league scoring (113.3 per 100) gives a lower environment, while the market prices a higher one; no source read today names a reason for a higher total, and no DraftKings total price was read. No total selected.

Props: no DraftKings player-prop price was readable today. TheSpread lists Jokic 10+ assists at -145 with no book named (Jokic's model assists mean 10.8, so a 9.5 or 10.5 DraftKings line would be worth a read); SI lists SGA over 30.5 points at -111 with an odds section citing DraftKings, while its spread disagrees with the feed. Neither is a DraftKings read the spec accepts. Declined; the owner should have the desk price these from a DraftKings page if wanted.
Result: no selections on this game. The desk's spread and moneyline probabilities are at or below break-even at the DraftKings prices; the wild card fails its floor.
